name: Project Plan
description: A persistent Markdown plan artifact tracking the agent's progress and planned work items.

attributes.note: Plan updates are all-or-nothing at the file-content level (no partial writes on failure) without temp-file replace/rename strategies. Concurrent writers are unsupported; last-write-wins behavior is acceptable.

item_format.description: Each open plan item follows a structured Markdown list format. Completed items retain only the header line.

fields.priority: Integer; lower value ships first (P0 before P1, etc.).
fields.description: Single 4-space-indented bullet. One sentence stating the gap or goal; may cite a design doc. Does not list deliverables.
fields.deliverables: 8-space-indented bullets under the description. Each is a specific, independently verifiable action or outcome.
fields.aurora_cards: 4-space-indented bullet listing linked Aurora card IDs as Markdown links relative to the plan file location.
fields.dependencies: 4-space-indented bullet listing item numbers that must be complete first. Omitted when there are no dependencies.

item_format.completed_items: Retain only the header line (N. [x] {title}); description and deliverables are dropped when an item is marked done.
